description: Filter every product Trueprice tracks across its Shopify stores, like the Product Finder at /product-finder (same filters, same results as GET /api/v1/finder). Drops are % below the product's highest in-stock price in the last 7 or 30 days (daily history starts 2026-11-13). new_days = listed by the store within N days (first seen after Trueprice's first read of that store). One currency at a time (default USD). Sorts: drop (dropped products first, biggest drop first), new (new listings first), price (lowest first), rating (best rated first), reviews (most reviewed first), rank (each product type's cheapest in-stock products first). Each row has rating + reviews from the store's review app and type_rank (#rank cheapest of `of` in-stock products of its product_type and currency). 20 results a page; each has a url to its Trueprice price-history page.

has_code.description: Only stores with a checked promo code

min_rating.description: Minimum star rating from the store's review app

new_days.description: Only products newly listed in the last N days

product_type.description: Shopify product type, exact, any case

query.description: Words that must all be in the title

name: find_products
title: Product Finder
